exceptions.title: adds [data-hovering] when the synthetic pointer target differs from the native path
exceptions.reason: The case dispatches `pointerover` and tests the target of a React synthetic enter event. A Vue listener gets the native event, whose path starts at its target. An own case covers the native event.

exceptions.title: allows overriding aria-hidden
exceptions.reason: The case gives `aria-hidden` the value `undefined` and asserts that the part removes the attribute. Vase UI keeps the value of the part for `undefined` and removes it for `null` (VUE-103). The case "VUE-103: aria-hidden of the consumer is $name" tests both values.
